summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with two tests (binary 2D and empty class). Nothing was run, per the instructions, so the tests are unverified; I checked the batch-of-two example by hand (TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss 0.333). Choices: the stored distance matrix is cast to the probabilities' device and dtype on each forward call, and the TP/D helpers use broadcast batch-pairing. One pre-existing line in dice.py (line 36) is 128 columns and was left alone. No commits were made.
